objective: Remove disjoint-core separation for one expanding shared-variable family and pay every finite restriction order with a dimension- and depth-independent retained-credit constant.
prior_status: A complete constant-3 adaptive payment was proved only for quadratic controls times arbitrary disjoint cores; shared-variable nonflat coupling was open.
mathematical_delta: Proved a complete constant-4 root-source payment for a quadratic star sharing all data variables with a point defect, for arbitrary adaptive/pruned restriction orders and arbitrary disjoint retained terminal cores. Derived H<=10I for the base family.
previous_bound: No dimension-independent complete-tree payment for this shared-variable class.
new_bound: U(F)-sum_l w_l U(F_l) <= 2 <= 4 I_special(F); base family H<=10I.

constant_ledger.overlap: complete overlap between the star phase and point-defect variables
constant_ledger.remaining_correlation_gap: multiple defects or arbitrary shared cores

verification.method: exact rational Walsh arithmetic and rational positive-series log intervals

remaining_obstacle: Replace the one-defect uniform tail by a nonreused filter refund for two or more coherent defects, then seek a directional queried-influence payment rather than the root special-block budget.
next_action: Derive the two-defect star spectral law by displacement-filter intersection type and test whether the single-defect constant survives without dependence on Hamming separation.
